paras.en: Now, it has revealed that a patch of space astronomers have been poring over for decades may yet hold some surprises.
paras.zh: 现在，它揭示了太空天文学家数十年来研究的一小片区域可能仍会带来一些惊喜。

paras.en: In a tiny corner of the tiny field, JWST detected a strange signal – not once, but twice, in observations nearly three months apart.
paras.zh: 在这片小田野的一个小角落里，JWST 检测到了一个奇怪的信号——不是一次，而是两次，观察间隔近三个月。

paras.en: There's just one problem. In every other prior observation from both JWST and Hubble, there's absolutely nothing there.
paras.zh: 只有一个问题。在 JWST 和哈勃望远镜之前的所有其他观测中，绝对没有任何东西。

paras.en: That doesn't mean that there is nothing there – there may be something otherwise too dim to detect that briefly unleashed a powerful flare – but it does make that signal a mystery that, currently, has no satisfying explanation.
paras.zh: 这并不意味着那里什么都没有——可能有一些东西太暗而无法探测到，短暂地释放了强大的耀斑——但它确实使这个信号成为一个谜，目前还没有令人满意的解释。

paras.en: To understand why this signal is so strange, though, first you need to know a little more about how astronomers study the Universe.
paras.zh: 然而，要理解为什么这个信号如此奇怪，首先你需要更多地了解天文学家如何研究宇宙。

paras.en: When you look into an optical telescope, you see an image formed from the light collected by its mirror. That's pretty much what you're looking at when you gaze upon the HUDF – a composite of images taken through different filters, each capturing a particular range of wavelengths.
paras.zh: 当您观察光学望远镜时，您会看到由镜子收集的光线形成的图像。当您凝视 HUDF 时，这几乎就是您所看到的——通过不同滤光片拍摄的图像的组合，每个滤光片捕获特定的波长范围。

paras.en: But some telescopes can also split light into different wavelengths – think of how a prism can split white light into a rainbow, but on a much more granular scale.
paras.zh: 但一些望远镜也可以将光分成不同的波长——想想棱镜如何将白光分成彩虹，但在更细粒度的尺度上。

paras.en: This can reveal features in the light that are hard to distinguish in a multi-wavelength image. For example, if you collect all the light from the Sun, it looks white; but when split into a spectrum, you'll see dark lines where specific wavelengths have been absorbed by atoms in the solar atmosphere.
paras.zh: 这可以揭示在多波长图像中难以区分的光特征。例如，如果你收集来自太阳的所有光，它看起来是白色的；但当分成光谱时，您会看到暗线，其中特定波长已被太阳大气中的原子吸收。

paras.en: Other objects produce bright lines instead, where atoms or molecules release energy as light at specific wavelengths. These are called emission lines.
paras.zh: 其他物体则产生亮线，其中原子或分子以特定波长的光形式释放能量。这些称为发射线。

paras.en: Astronomers use a technique called spectroscopy to detect these absorption and emission lines, a clever way to determine the chemical composition and other properties of astrophysical objects.
paras.zh: 天文学家使用一种称为光谱学的技术来检测这些吸收线和发射线，这是确定天体物理物体的化学成分和其他特性的巧妙方法。

paras.en: Astrophysicist Mason Huberty of the University of Minnesota and colleagues wanted to try something a little bit different.
paras.zh: 明尼苏达大学的天体物理学家梅森·休伯蒂和同事想要尝试一些不同的东西。

paras.en: Rather than using spectroscopy to study already known objects, they wanted to see if JWST's Near-Infrared Spectrograph (NIRSpec) could be used as a tool to find objects that hadn't been found yet.
paras.zh: 他们不想使用光谱学来研究已知的物体，而是想看看 JWST 的近红外光谱仪 (NIRSpec) 是否可以用作寻找尚未发现的物体的工具。

paras.en: Normally, astronomers select known targets from existing observations, and then position the instrument's tiny shutters so that light from the selected target enters the spectrograph. It's a really useful technique, with one limitation – it relies on knowing where the target is first.
paras.zh: 通常，天文学家从现有观测中选择已知目标，然后定位仪器的微型快门，以便来自所选目标的光进入光谱仪。这是一种非常有用的技术，但有一个限制——它依赖于知道目标首先在哪里。

paras.en: Huberty and his team did sort of the complete opposite.
paras.zh: 休伯蒂和他的团队做了完全相反的事情。

paras.en: They opened up nearly all the shutters, closing only those covering known foreground objects identified in previous Hubble observations, whose light could contaminate the spectra they wanted to collect.
paras.zh: 他们打开了几乎所有的百叶窗，只关闭那些覆盖先前哈勃观测中识别出的已知前景物体的百叶窗，这些物体的光可能会污染他们想要收集的光谱。

paras.en: Then, they split the light collected into spectra and searched the resulting data for emission lines.
paras.zh: 然后，他们将收集到的光分成光谱，并在所得数据中搜索发射线。

paras.en: And they did it twice – two observation windows, 88 days apart in August and November 2023, and – crucially – at different observation angles. This would help eliminate artifacts and glitches.
paras.zh: 他们做了两次——两个观察窗口，分别在 2023 年 8 月和 11 月，相隔 88 天，而且最重要的是——在不同的观察角度。这将有助于消除伪影和故障。

paras.en: The aim was to find faint, distant objects that conventional observations might have missed, using a technique called Multiobject Coronagraphy for Slitless Spectroscopy (MOCSS).
paras.zh: 其目的是使用一种称为无缝光谱多目标日冕术（MOCSS）的技术来寻找传统观测可能错过的微弱遥远天体。

paras.en: The HUDF was an ideal testing ground, with its wealth of existing observations allowing the researchers to check their results against known galaxies.
paras.zh: HUDF 是一个理想的试验场，其丰富的现有观测数据使研究人员能够根据已知星系检查他们的结果。

paras.en: And it worked. After all was said and done, six detections that passed their strict criteria could be matched to distant galaxies in the HUDF.
paras.zh: 它奏效了。总而言之，通过严格标准的六个探测结果可以与 HUDF 中的遥远星系相匹配。

paras.en: It was a single, bright line that appeared in both near-infrared observations at about 1.6 micrometers. In isolation, that's not so weird; near-infrared emission is super normal.
paras.zh: 这是一条约 1.6 微米的单条亮线，出现在两次近红外观测中。孤立地看，这并不奇怪。近红外发射超正常。

paras.en: It's the isolation that caused the drama. There was no other emission line accompanying it – and in prior observations from Hubble and JWST, nothing else could be seen in that patch of space.
paras.zh: 正是这种孤立造成了戏剧性的后果。没有其他发射线伴随它——而且在哈勃望远镜和 JWST 之前的观测中，在那片空间中看不到任何其他东西。

paras.en: It can't easily be explained away as a glitch, either. It appeared in all four sets of combined exposures, across both observing orientations, 88 days apart, and the measurements were consistent.
paras.zh: 它也不能轻易地被解释为一个小故障。它出现在所有四组组合曝光中，跨两个观察方向，相隔 88 天，并且测量结果是一致的。

paras.en: Here's the real kicker. The emission line was bright enough that it should have shown up in the earlier JWST images.
paras.zh: 这是真正的关键。发射线足够亮，应该会出现在早期的 JWST 图像中。

paras.en: Had it been present during JWST's JADES survey conducted in October 2022, there's no way the telescope could have missed it.
paras.zh: 如果它在 2022 年 10 月 JWST 进行的 JADES 巡天期间出现过，望远镜就不可能错过它。

paras.en: Which raises the possibility that maybe it wasn't present then.
paras.zh: 这就提出了一种可能性，即当时它并不存在。

paras.en: But just one line is really tricky to identify, unless you know exactly how far away it is. That's because, as space expands, it stretches light into redder and redder wavelengths.
paras.zh: 但只有一条线确实很难识别，除非你确切知道它有多远。这是因为，随着空间的膨胀，它会将光拉伸成越来越红的波长。

paras.en: So an infrared photon could be energetic light from really far away, or less energetic light from much closer; you need more information than just its wavelength to figure out which it is – and how it was produced.
paras.zh: 因此，红外光子可能是来自很远的地方的高能光，也可能是来自更近的地方的低能光。你需要更多的信息而不仅仅是它的波长来弄清楚它是什么以及它是如何产生的。

paras.en: There are several different things that maybe could have produced the emission line – with four main suspects, none of which fit the bill cleanly.
paras.zh: 有几种不同的东西可能会产生排放线——有四个主要嫌疑人，但没有一个完全符合要求。

paras.en: A galaxy in the early Universe is the first in the lineup, with two main problems – that emission line would struggle to travel through the neutral hydrogen that filled the early Universe, and it should have appeared in the JADES observations.
paras.zh: 早期宇宙中的星系是该系列中的第一个，它有两个主要问题——发射线很难穿过充满早期宇宙的中性氢，而且它应该出现在 JADES 观测中。

paras.en: A more recent galaxy could also be the culprit, but – in addition to the JADES problem – it should have other emission lines, not just the one.
paras.zh: 一个更新的星系也可能是罪魁祸首，但是——除了 JADES 问题之外——它应该还有其他发射线，而不仅仅是一条。

paras.en: It could have been a supernova, but again, it should have produced another emission line that wasn't detected.
paras.zh: 它可能是一颗超新星，但同样，它应该产生另一条未被检测到的发射线。

paras.en: And finally, a black hole tearing apart a star can produce a strong emission line, even without much other detectable light. But there's not enough evidence to establish that this is what happened.
paras.zh: 最后，即使没有太多其他可检测到的光，撕裂恒星的黑洞也可以产生强烈的发射线。但没有足够的证据证明这就是所发生的事情。

paras.en: Which means that there's only one thing to do.
paras.zh: 这意味着只有一件事要做。

paras.en: "This object is highly unusual and probes extreme physical conditions," the researchers write.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“这个物体非常不寻常，可以探测极端的物理条件。”

paras.en: "Follow-up observations are essential to confirm the redshift and determine the physical origin of the emission … Deeper, more sensitive spectroscopy could reveal additional emission lines and definitively establish the redshift and nature of the source."
paras.zh: “后续观测对于确认红移和确定发射的物理起源至关重要……更深、更灵敏​​的光谱可以揭示额外的发射线，并明确确定红移和源的性质。”

paras.en: The research has been published in The Astrophysical Journal.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《天体物理学杂志》上。

articles.title: Scientists reveal 93% of Australia's Indigenous population was lost in just 73 years

paras.en: Scientists reveal 93% of Australia's Indigenous population was lost in just 73 years
paras.zh: 科学家揭示澳大利亚93%的原住民人口在短短73年内消失

paras.en: - A groundbreaking study suggests that 2.22 million Indigenous Australians lived on the continent before European colonization, far more than previously believed. Researchers estimate that 93% of this population was lost within 73 years, revealing a demographic catastrophe on a scale that dramatically changes our understanding of Australian history.
paras.zh: - 一项开创性的研究表明，在欧洲殖民之前，有 222 万澳大利亚原住民生活在这片大陆上，远远超出了之前的预期。研究人员估计，93% 的人口在 73 年内消失，这揭示了一场人口灾难，其规模极大地改变了我们对澳大利亚历史的理解。

paras.en: New research suggests that Australia's Indigenous population before European colonization was far larger than historical estimates have indicated. Scientists now estimate that approximately 2.22 million Indigenous people lived across the continent before the arrival of the First Fleet in 1788, potentially up to seven times the number suggested by some earlier calculations.
paras.zh: 新的研究表明，欧洲殖民之前澳大利亚的原住民人口远远多于历史估计。科学家们现在估计，在 1788 年第一舰队抵达之前，大约有 222 万原住民生活在这片大陆上，这一数字可能是一些早期计算得出的数字的七倍。

paras.en: The findings also reveal the devastating scale of the population decline that followed colonization. According to the researchers, an estimated 93% of Australia's Indigenous population was lost within less than 80 years of European arrival, a much greater decline than previously recognized.
paras.zh: 研究结果还揭示了殖民化后人口急剧下降的严重程度。据研究人员称，估计 93% 的澳大利亚原住民人口在欧洲人抵达后不到 80 年内就消失了，下降幅度比之前认识的要大得多。

paras.en: Professor Corey Bradshaw, a Global Ecology Professor at Flinders University and Chief Investigator at the Australian Research Council Centre of Excellence for Indigenous and Environmental Histories and Futures (CIEHF), contributed to the national research effort. Working alongside Indigenous partners, the team is investigating how Indigenous population numbers have changed throughout Australia's history.
paras.zh: 弗林德斯大学全球生态学教授、澳大利亚研究委员会土著和环境历史与未来卓越中心（CIEHF）首席研究员科里·布拉德肖（Corey Bradshaw）教授为国家研究工作做出了贡献。该团队与原住民合作伙伴合作，正在调查原住民人口数量在澳大利亚历史上是如何变化的。

paras.en: By combining advanced computer models with several sources of historical and scientific evidence, the researchers developed new estimates that substantially challenge previous assumptions.
paras.zh: 通过将先进的计算机模型与多种历史和科学证据来源相结合，研究人员得出了新的估计，极大地挑战了之前的假设。

paras.en: "Understanding the size of Indigenous populations in Australia before European invasion in 1788 is essential to truth-telling and reconciliation," says Professor Bradshaw.
paras.zh: “了解 1788 年欧洲入侵之前澳大利亚土著人口的规模对于讲真话与和解至关重要，”布拉德肖教授说。

paras.en: New Evidence Reveals Millions of Indigenous Australians Before Colonization
paras.zh: 新证据显示数百万澳大利亚原住民在殖民化之前

paras.en: To reconstruct Australia's Indigenous population before European settlement, the researchers brought together ethnographic observations, archaeological findings, genetic reconstructions, and computer models. They also examined how many people different environments across the continent could have supported.
paras.zh: 为了重建欧洲殖民之前澳大利亚的原住民人口，研究人员汇集了人种学观察、考古发现、遗传重建和计算机模型。他们还研究了整个大陆的不同环境可以支持多少人。

paras.en: Earlier population estimates often relied heavily on calculations made during the 1930s by anthropologist Alfred Radcliffe-Brown. His influential assessment placed Australia's Indigenous population before colonization at approximately 250,000 people.
paras.zh: 早期的人口估计通常在很大程度上依赖于人类学家阿尔弗雷德·拉德克利夫-布朗 (Alfred Radcliffe-Brown) 在 20 世纪 30 年代所做的计算。他的影响力评估显示，殖民前澳大利亚原住民人口约为 250,000 人。

paras.en: However, Radcliffe-Brown recognized that his estimate did not fully account for the devastating effects of deadly diseases, violence along colonial frontiers, and broader structural violence. Subsequent research has shown that these forces had a much greater impact than was historically acknowledged, suggesting that many early population figures were already substantial underestimates.
paras.zh: 然而，拉德克利夫-布朗承认，他的估计并未充分考虑致命疾病、殖民边境暴力以及更广泛的结构性暴力的破坏性影响。随后的研究表明，这些力量的影响比历史上承认的要大得多，这表明许多早期的人口数据已经被大大低估了。

paras.en: Using modeled and genetics-based estimates (supported by, but not relying on, historical or ethnographic accounts), the team calculated a median Indigenous population of 2.22 million before colonization. This corresponds to approximately 0.29 people per square kilometer across Australia.
paras.zh: 使用模型和基于遗传学的估计（得到历史或人种学记载的支持，但不依赖于此），该团队计算出殖民之前原住民人口中位数为 222 万。这相当于澳大利亚每平方公里大约有 0.29 人。

paras.en: The figure is substantially higher than earlier historical estimates, which generally ranged from 250,000 to 1 million people.
paras.zh: 这个数字大大高于早期的历史估计，一般在 25 万到 100 万人之间。

paras.en: Researchers believe those lower estimates were influenced by the widespread population losses caused by disease, frontier violence, and systemic oppression before the earliest Australian censuses were conducted.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这些较低的估计值是由于在澳大利亚最早进行人口普查之前，疾病、边境暴力和系统性压迫造成的广泛人口流失的影响。

paras.en: A Devastating 93% Population Collapse After 1788
paras.zh: 1788 年之后，毁灭性的 93% 人口锐减

paras.en: The revised population estimate also allowed scientists to calculate the scale of the demographic catastrophe that followed European colonization.
paras.zh: 修订后的人口估计数还使科学家能够计算出欧洲殖民统治后人口灾难的规模。

paras.en: Using their model alongside early census records, the researchers estimated that approximately 2.06 million excess deaths occurred between 1788 and 1861. That represents an average of roughly 28,200 excess deaths annually over the 73-year period.
paras.zh: 研究人员利用他们的模型和早期人口普查记录估计，1788 年至 1861 年间大约有 206 万人超额死亡。这意味着在 73 年期间，每年平均约有 28,200 人超额死亡。

paras.en: By 1861, the Indigenous population had declined to an estimated 7% of its size before colonization, representing a staggering 93% reduction.
paras.zh: 到 1861 年，土著人口估计已减少至殖民前规模的 7%，减少了 93%，令人震惊。

paras.en: "These devastating findings highlight the major impacts of invasion experienced by Indigenous Australians, and demonstrate their remarkable survival, resilience and recovery over the past century," says lead author Associate Professor Alan Williams, a Partner Investigator in CIEHF representing EMM Consulting and who is also an Adjunct Research Fellow at James Cook University.
paras.zh: “这些毁灭性的发现突显了澳大利亚原住民所经历的入侵的重大影响，并展示了他们在过去一个世纪中非凡的生存、复原力和恢复能力，”主要作者、代表 EMM Consulting 的 CIEHF 合作研究员、詹姆斯库克大学兼职研究员艾伦·威廉姆斯 (Alan Williams) 副教授说道。

paras.en: Although Australia's Indigenous population has increased since the 1950s, it has not yet returned to its estimated size before European arrival.
paras.zh: 尽管澳大利亚原住民人口自 20 世纪 50 年代以来有所增加，但尚未恢复到欧洲人到来之前的估计规模。

paras.en: According to the 2021 Australian census, the Indigenous population was approximately 37% of the study's estimated median population in 1788.
paras.zh: 根据 2021 年澳大利亚人口普查，1788 年土著人口约占该研究估计人口中位数的 37%。

paras.en: If population growth continues along current trends, the researchers project that Indigenous population numbers may not return to their estimated pre-colonial level until around 2047.
paras.zh: 如果人口继续按照目前的趋势增长，研究人员预计土著人口数量可能要到 2047 年左右才能恢复到殖民前的估计水平。

paras.en: What the Findings Mean for Australia's History
paras.zh: 研究结果对澳大利亚历史意味着什么

paras.en: Beyond revising historical population figures, the study highlights the long-lasting consequences of colonization for Indigenous Australians.
paras.zh: 除了修改历史人口数据之外，该研究还强调了殖民化对澳大利亚土著人的长期影响。

paras.en: The researchers say the scale of the demographic collapse has important implications for understanding intergenerational trauma, persistent disadvantage, and the development of policies that better support Indigenous communities.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，人口崩溃的规模对于理解代际创伤、持续的劣势以及制定更好支持原住民社区的政策具有重要意义。

paras.en: "The findings highlight the scale of demographic catastrophe experienced by Indigenous Australians due to colonization, with the implications being a heightened understanding of intergenerational trauma and to inform future policy that assists Indigenous people. In addition to recognizing this intergenerational trauma and disadvantage, it is also time to recognize intergenerational privilege," says co-author Distinguished Professor Lynette Russell of the Monash University Indigenous Studies Centre and CIEHF.
paras.zh: “研究结果突显了澳大利亚原住民因殖民化而经历的人口灾难的规模，其影响是加深对代际创伤的理解，并为未来帮助原住民的政策提供信息。除了认识到这种代际创伤和劣势之外，现在也是时候认识到代际特权了，”莫纳什大学原住民研究中心和 CIEHF 的共同作者、杰出教授 Lynette Russell 说。

paras.en: The findings also demonstrate why scientists must draw on several independent methods when reconstructing population histories, particularly when written records are incomplete, unreliable, or shaped by historical biases.
paras.zh: 研究结果还证明了为什么科学家在重建人口历史时必须利用几种独立的方法，特别是当书面记录不完整、不可靠或受到历史偏见影响时。

paras.en: By combining genetic research, archaeological evidence, environmental modeling, and historical information, the team was able to develop a more comprehensive picture of Australia's Indigenous population before and after European colonization.
paras.zh: 通过结合基因研究、考古证据、环境模型和历史信息，该团队能够更全面地了解欧洲殖民前后澳大利亚土著人口的情况。

paras.en: Distinguished Professor Larissa Behrendt AO, Chair of the CIEHF Centre Advisory Committee, says the findings demand a fundamental reassessment of the country's history while also recognizing the extraordinary endurance of Indigenous Australians.
paras.zh: CIEHF 中心咨询委员会主席、杰出教授 Larissa Behrendt AO 表示，调查结果要求对澳大利亚的历史进行根本性的重新评估，同时也要认识到澳大利亚原住民非凡的忍耐力。

paras.en: "These research findings challenge us to rethink the scale of what happened after 1788. We are not talking about a marginal consequence of colonization but a demographic catastrophe at the heart of the Australian story. But the research also tells us something extraordinary. Our survival is one of Australian history's most remarkable stories," said Distinguished Professor Larissa Behrendt AO Chair, CIEHF Centre Advisory Committee.
paras.zh: “这些研究结果要求我们重新思考 1788 年之后发生的事情的规模。我们谈论的不是殖民化的边际后果，而是澳大利亚故事核心的人口灾难。但这项研究也告诉我们一些非同寻常的事情。我们的生存是澳大利亚历史上最引人注目的故事之一，”CIEHF 中心咨询委员会主席、杰出教授 Larissa Behrendt AO 说道。

paras.en: The study, "Large size of the Australian Indigenous population prior to its massive decline following colonial invasion," was published in Nature Human Behaviour. Its authors are Alan Williams, Raymond Tobler, Billy Griffiths, Sean Ulm, Matthew Nitschke, Michael Bird, Shane Ingrey, Frédérik Saltré, Kirsty Beller, Ian McNiven, Nicholas Pitt, Lynette Russell, Alistair Paterson, Christopher Wilson, and Corey Bradshaw.
paras.zh: 这项研究发表在《自然·人类行为》杂志上，题为“澳大利亚原住民人口在殖民入侵后大幅下降之前的规模”。其作者包括艾伦·威廉姆斯、雷蒙德·托布勒、比利·格里菲思、肖恩·乌尔姆、马修·尼奇克、迈克尔·伯德、肖恩·英格雷、弗雷德里克·索尔特、科斯蒂·贝勒、伊恩·麦克尼文、尼古拉斯·皮特、莱内特·拉塞尔、阿利斯泰尔·帕特森、克里斯托弗·威尔逊和科里·布拉德肖。

paras.en: The research received joint funding from the Australian Research Council Centre of Excellence for Indigenous and Environmental Histories and Futures (CE230100009) and the Australian Research Council Centre of Excellence for Australian Biodiversity and Heritage (CE17010001).
paras.zh: 该研究获得了澳大利亚研究委员会土著和环境历史与未来卓越中心（CE230100009）和澳大利亚研究委员会澳大利亚生物多样性和遗产卓越中心（CE17010001）的联合资助。

paras.en: Materials provided by Flinders University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由弗林德斯大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: A 47-year study reveals the age when your body starts losing strength

paras.en: A 47-year study reveals the age when your body starts losing strength
paras.zh: 一项历时 47 年的研究揭示了您的身体开始失去力量的年龄

paras.en: - A 47-year study has uncovered a surprising turning point in physical aging: fitness and strength begin declining around age 35, even among people who exercise regularly. Researchers found that this decline accelerates as people get older, but starting to exercise in adulthood can still improve physical performance.
paras.zh: - 一项历时 47 年的研究发现了身体衰老的一个令人惊讶的转折点：体能和力量在 35 岁左右开始下降，即使是经常锻炼的人也是如此。研究人员发现，随着人们年龄的增长，这种衰退会加速，但成年后开始锻炼仍然可以提高身体表现。

paras.en: Aging may begin to affect your physical abilities earlier than you expect. A remarkable 47-year Swedish study found that fitness, muscle endurance, and physical performance generally begin declining around age 35, even among people who remain active.
paras.zh: 衰老可能会比您预期的更早开始影响您的身体能力。瑞典一项历时 47 年的引人注目的研究发现，健康、肌肉耐力和身体表现通常在 35 岁左右开始下降，即使对于保持活跃的人也是如此。

paras.en: But the findings also offer an encouraging message. Although exercise cannot completely prevent the physical changes associated with aging, becoming more active during adulthood can still produce meaningful improvements in fitness and strength.
paras.zh: 但研究结果也提供了令人鼓舞的信息。尽管锻炼不能完全阻止与衰老相关的身体变化，但在成年期间变得更加活跃仍然可以对健康和力量产生有意义的改善。

paras.en: Researchers at Karolinska Institutet in Sweden spent nearly five decades tracking how people's physical abilities changed as they grew older. Their findings, published in 2025 in the Journal of Cachexia, Sarcopenia and Muscle, help explain when physical decline begins, how it progresses, and why staying active remains important throughout life.
paras.zh: 瑞典卡罗林斯卡学院的研究人员花了近五年的时间来追踪人们的身体能力如何随着年龄的增长而变化。他们的研究结果于 2025 年发表在《恶病质、肌肉减少症和肌肉杂志》上，有助于解释身体衰退何时开始、如何进展，以及为什么保持活跃在一生中仍然很重要。

paras.en: A 47-Year Study Reveals When Physical Fitness Peaks
paras.zh: 一项历时 47 年的研究揭示了身体健康何时达到顶峰

paras.en: The research was part of the Swedish Physical Activity and Fitness study (SPAF), which followed 427 randomly selected men and women born in 1958. Participants underwent physical assessments over 47 years, beginning at age 16 and continuing through age 63.
paras.zh: 该研究是瑞典体育活动和健身研究 (SPAF) 的一部分，该研究随机选择了 427 名 1958 年出生的男性和女性。参与者从 16 岁开始一直持续到 63 岁，接受了 47 年来的身体评估。

paras.en: Unlike most earlier research on physical aging, which compared people of different ages at a single point in time, this project repeatedly examined the same individuals as they grew older.
paras.zh: 与大多数早期的身体衰老研究不同的是，该项目在同一时间点对不同年龄的人进行比较，而该项目随着年龄的增长而反复检查同一个人。

paras.en: That distinction matters because physical abilities vary considerably from person to person. Following individuals over decades allowed researchers to observe how fitness changed within the same population rather than relying on comparisons between different generations.
paras.zh: 这种区别很重要，因为人与人之间的身体能力差异很大。通过对个体进行数十年的跟踪，研究人员可以观察同一群体内的健康状况如何变化，而不是依赖于不同世代之间的比较。

paras.en: The assessments included aerobic fitness, muscular endurance, and muscle power. Aerobic fitness describes how effectively the body uses oxygen during exercise, while muscular endurance measures how long muscles can continue working. Muscle power reflects the ability to produce force quickly, which is important for activities such as jumping, climbing stairs, and maintaining mobility.
paras.zh: 评估包括有氧健身、肌肉耐力和肌肉力量。有氧健身描述了身体在运动过程中如何有效地利用氧气，而肌肉耐力则衡量了肌肉可以持续工作的时间。肌肉力量反映了快速产生力量的能力，这对于跳跃、爬楼梯和保持活动能力等活动很重要。

paras.en: The results revealed a consistent pattern. Aerobic fitness and muscular endurance generally reached their highest levels between ages 26 and 36, with physical performance beginning to decline around the mid-30s. Some abilities, particularly explosive muscle power, peaked even earlier.
paras.zh: 结果显示出一致的模式。有氧运动和肌肉耐力一般在26岁至36岁之间达到最高水平，而身体机能在30多岁左右开始下降。有些能力，特别是肌肉爆发力，甚至更早达到顶峰。

paras.en: The decline was initially modest but became progressively faster with age. By age 63, average performance across the measurements had fallen by roughly 30 to 48 percent from peak levels.
paras.zh: 最初下降幅度不大，但随着年龄的增长，下降速度逐渐加快。到 63 岁时，各项测量的平均表现较峰值水平下降了约 30% 至 48%。

paras.en: Importantly, the pattern appeared in both men and women. Although individual fitness levels differed, the overall rates of age-related decline were similar between the sexes.
paras.zh: 重要的是，这种模式在男性和女性身上都出现了。尽管个体健康水平存在差异，但两性之间与年龄相关的总体下降率相似。

paras.en: Exercise Can Slow Physical Decline, Even After 35
paras.zh: 运动可以延缓身体衰退，即使在 35 岁之后也是如此

paras.en: One of the most striking findings was that regular physical activity did not entirely prevent the decline associated with aging. Even people who remained physically active showed evidence of diminishing performance as they grew older.
paras.zh: 最引人注目的发现之一是，定期的体育活动并不能完全阻止与衰老相关的衰退。即使是那些保持身体活跃的人，随着年龄的增长，他们的表现也会下降。

paras.en: However, exercise made an important difference in how well people maintained their abilities.
paras.zh: 然而，锻炼对人们保持能力的程度产生了重要影响。

paras.en: Participants who became physically active during adulthood experienced improvements in physical capacity of approximately 5 to 10 percent. Those who were already active during adolescence also tended to maintain better fitness, endurance, and muscle power throughout adulthood.
paras.zh: 在成年期间进行身体活动的参与者的身体能力提高了大约 5% 至 10%。那些在青春期就已经活跃的人在整个成年期也往往保持更好的健康、耐力和肌肉力量。

paras.en: These findings suggest that physical decline is not simply the result of becoming less active with age. Biological changes also appear to contribute, although exercise can help reduce their impact.
paras.zh: 这些发现表明，身体衰退不仅仅是随着年龄的增长而变得不那么活跃的结果。生物变化似乎也有所贡献，尽管锻炼可以帮助减少其影响。

paras.en: "It is never too late to start moving. Our study shows that physical activity can slow the decline in performance, even if it cannot completely stop it. Now we will look for the mechanisms behind why everyone reaches their peak performance at age 35 and why physical activity can slow performance loss but not completely halt it," says Maria Westerståhl, lecturer at the Department of Laboratory Medicine and lead author of the study.
paras.zh: “开始运动永远不会太晚。我们的研究表明，体力活动可以减缓性能下降，即使它不能完全阻止它。现在我们将寻找为什么每个人在 35 岁时达到巅峰性能以及为什么体力活动可以减缓性能下降但不能完全阻止它背后的机制，”实验医学系讲师、该研究的主要作者 Maria Westerståhl 说。

paras.en: The distinction is important. Reaching an average physical peak in the mid-30s does not mean everyone suddenly becomes weaker at that age. People can continue improving their individual fitness and strength through training, even after the age when population averages begin to decline.
paras.zh: 区别很重要。在30多岁左右达到平均体力高峰并不意味着每个人在这个年龄段都会突然变得虚弱。即使在人口平均值开始下降的年龄之后，人们也可以通过训练继续提高个人健康和力量。

paras.en: Why Does the Body Start Losing Strength?
paras.zh: 为什么身体开始失去力量？

paras.en: Scientists are still investigating exactly why physical performance begins deteriorating relatively early in adulthood.
paras.zh: 科学家们仍在调查为什么身体机能在成年后相对较早就开始恶化。

paras.en: Several biological processes are thought to contribute. As people age, changes in muscle cells, the nervous system, and the body's ability to produce energy can gradually reduce physical performance.
paras.zh: 人们认为有几种生物过程对此有贡献。随着人们年龄的增长，肌肉细胞、神经系统和身体产生能量的能力的变化会逐渐降低身体表现。

paras.en: One possible contributor involves mitochondria, the tiny structures inside cells that convert nutrients into usable energy. Changes in mitochondrial function may affect how efficiently muscles produce the energy required for movement.
paras.zh: 一个可能的贡献者涉及线粒体，它是细胞内的微小结构，可将营养物质转化为可用能量。线粒体功能的变化可能会影响肌肉产生运动所需能量的效率。

paras.en: Over time, muscles can also lose mass and become less responsive to the signals that trigger growth and repair. More advanced muscle deterioration can contribute to sarcopenia, an age-related condition involving the loss of muscle strength and mass that can make everyday activities increasingly difficult.
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，肌肉也会失去质量，并且对触发生长和修复的信号的反应变得不那么敏感。更严重的肌肉退化会导致肌肉减少症，这是一种与年龄相关的疾病，涉及肌肉力量和质量的丧失，使日常活动变得越来越困难。

paras.en: Although these processes often become more noticeable later in life, the Swedish findings suggest that some underlying changes in physical function begin decades earlier.
paras.zh: 尽管这些过程往往在晚年变得更加明显，但瑞典的研究结果表明，身体机能的一些潜在变化早在几十年前就开始了。

paras.en: The researchers hope to determine which biological mechanisms drive this decline and why physical activity can delay, but not completely prevent, the loss of performance.
paras.zh: 研究人员希望确定哪些生物机制导致了这种下降，以及为什么体力活动可以延缓但不能完全防止表现下降。

paras.en: Follow-Up Research Links Early Fitness to Heart Health
paras.zh: 后续研究将早期健身与心脏健康联系起来

paras.en: The importance of maintaining physical fitness throughout adulthood extends beyond muscle strength.
paras.zh: 在整个成年期保持身体健康的重要性不仅仅是肌肉力量。

paras.en: In a 2026 follow-up study published in Scientific Reports, researchers examined additional health outcomes using the same Swedish cohort. They found that people with better aerobic fitness at ages 34 and 52 tended to have less arterial stiffness at age 63.
paras.zh: 在《科学报告》上发表的 2026 年后续研究中，研究人员使用同一瑞典队列检查了其他健康结果。他们发现，34 岁和 52 岁时有氧运动能力较好的人在 63 岁时动脉僵硬度往往较低。

paras.en: Arterial stiffness occurs when blood vessels become less flexible, making it harder for them to expand and contract as blood moves through the body. Greater stiffness is associated with increased cardiovascular risk.
paras.zh: 当血管变得不太灵活时，就会出现动脉僵硬，使血液在体内流动时更难以扩张和收缩。更大的硬度与心血管风险增加相关。

paras.en: Notably, the relationship between earlier fitness and later artery health remained significant even after accounting for several established cardiovascular risk factors, including obesity, smoking, and blood pressure.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，即使考虑了肥胖、吸烟和血压等几个已确定的心血管危险因素，早期健康与后期动脉健康之间的关系仍然显着。

paras.en: The results do not establish that better fitness directly prevented arterial stiffening. However, they suggest that maintaining aerobic capacity during early and middle adulthood may have benefits that extend well into later life.
paras.zh: 结果并不能证明更好的健身可以直接预防动脉硬化。然而，他们认为，在成年早期和中期保持有氧能力可能会带来好处，并持续到以后的生活。

paras.en: More Evidence That Staying Active Pays Off
paras.zh: 更多证据表明保持活跃是有回报的

paras.en: Other research has reinforced the idea that exercise remains valuable even when physical performance inevitably declines with age.
paras.zh: 其他研究也强化了这样的观点：即使身体机能不可避免地随着年龄的增长而下降，锻炼仍然很有价值。

paras.en: A 2026 study published in GeroScience followed 82 older adults who continued cycling over a nine-year period. Despite maintaining active lifestyles, participants experienced an average 19.7 percent decline in peak aerobic capacity.
paras.zh: 《GeroScience》于 2026 年发表的一项研究跟踪了 82 名在 9 年时间内继续骑自行车的老年人。尽管保持积极的生活方式，参与者的峰值有氧能力平均下降了 19.7%。

paras.en: Yet their fitness remained remarkably high. Nearly all participants who completed the exercise test performed at or above the 90th percentile for their age when compared with reference populations.
paras.zh: 然而他们的健康状况仍然非常高。与参考人群相比，几乎所有完成运动测试的参与者的表现都达到或超过其年龄的 90%。

paras.en: The findings suggest that although regular exercise cannot eliminate biological aging, it can help people maintain unusually high levels of physical function as they get older.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，虽然经常锻炼不能消除生物衰老，但它可以帮助人们在变老时保持异常高水平的身体机能。

paras.en: Another 2026 study in The American Journal of Medicine followed 49 men ages 60 to 82 who had not previously participated in structured exercise training.
paras.zh: 《美国医学杂志》于 2026 年进行的另一项研究跟踪了 49 名年龄在 60 至 82 岁之间的男性，他们之前从未参加过结构化运动训练。

paras.en: Over four years, participants who performed weekly resistance exercises improved their upper and lower body strength. Those who combined resistance training with aerobic exercise also improved their aerobic fitness.
paras.zh: 四年来，每周进行抗阻训练的参与者提高了上半身和下半身的力量。那些将阻力训练与有氧运动相结合的人也改善了他们的有氧运动。

paras.en: Although the study was relatively small and participants chose their training programs, its findings support the idea that meaningful physical improvements remain possible well into older adulthood.
paras.zh: 尽管这项研究规模相对较小，并且参与者选择了自己的训练计划，但其研究结果支持了这样的观点：在老年时期，有意义的身体改善仍然是可能的。

paras.en: It's Never Too Late to Improve Your Fitness
paras.zh: 改善健康永远不会太晚

paras.en: The original Swedish research is continuing, with investigators planning another round of assessments when participants reach age 68.
paras.zh: 瑞典最初的研究仍在继续，研究人员计划在参与者年满 68 岁时进行另一轮评估。

paras.en: The next stage is intended to explore how long-term changes in physical performance relate to lifestyle, overall health, and the biological processes responsible for aging.
paras.zh: 下一阶段的目的是探索身体机能的长期变化与生活方式、整体健康以及导致衰老的生物过程之间的关系。

paras.en: Together, the findings point to an important distinction between getting older and becoming physically inactive. Some loss of fitness and strength appears to be a natural part of aging, but the extent of that decline can vary substantially.
paras.zh: 总之，这些发现指出了变老和缺乏身体活动之间的重要区别。一些健康和力量的丧失似乎是衰老的自然组成部分，但下降的程度可能有很大差异。

paras.en: While the body may begin losing some of its physical capabilities around age 35, those changes do not eliminate the benefits of exercise. Whether someone begins exercising in their 30s, 50s, or later, becoming more active can still help improve physical performance and preserve the abilities needed for a healthier, more independent life.
paras.zh: 虽然身体可能在 35 岁左右开始丧失一些身体机能，但这些变化并不会消除锻炼的好处。无论一个人是在 30 多岁、50 多岁还是更晚的时候开始锻炼，变得更加活跃仍然有助于提高身体表现并保留更健康、更独立的生活所需的能力。

paras.en: Materials provided by Karolinska Insitutet. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由卡罗林斯卡学院提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: Ozempic and Wegovy linked to rare risk of sudden vision loss

paras.en: Ozempic and Wegovy linked to rare risk of sudden vision loss
paras.zh: Ozempic 和 Wegovy 与罕见的突然视力丧失风险有关

paras.en: A large study links popular weight loss and diabetes drugs to a rare but potentially permanent form of vision loss, raising new questions about their safety.
paras.zh: 一项大型研究将流行的减肥和糖尿病药物与一种罕见但可能永久性的视力丧失联系起来，引发了有关其安全性的新问题。

paras.en: - Popular diabetes and weight loss drugs such as Ozempic and Wegovy have been linked to a slightly increased risk of a rare condition that can cause sudden, potentially permanent vision loss. Although the risk remains very low, Rutgers researchers say the findings warrant attention as millions of people turn to GLP-1 medications.
paras.zh: - 流行的糖尿病和减肥药物（例如 Ozempic 和 Wegovy）与一种罕见疾病的风险略有增加有关，这种罕见疾病可能导致突然的、可能永久性的视力丧失。尽管风险仍然很低，但罗格斯大学的研究人员表示，随着数百万人转向 GLP-1 药物，这些发现值得关注。

paras.en: A large study led by Rutgers researchers has identified a possible vision risk associated with widely used diabetes and weight loss medications, including Ozempic and Wegovy. The findings suggest that people taking these drugs may face a slightly higher risk of developing a rare eye condition that can cause sudden and potentially permanent vision loss.
paras.zh: 罗格斯大学研究人员领导的一项大型研究发现，广泛使用的糖尿病和减肥药物（包括 Ozempic 和 Wegovy）可能存在视力风险。研究结果表明，服用这些药物的人可能面临稍高的患罕见眼部疾病的风险，这种疾病可能导致突然且可能永久性的视力丧失。

paras.en: The condition, known as ischemic optic neuropathy, occurs when blood flow to the optic nerve is reduced. Because the optic nerve carries visual information from the eye to the brain, damage to it can lead to significant vision problems.
paras.zh: 这种情况被称为缺血性视神经病变，当流向视神经的血流减少时就会发生。由于视神经将视觉信息从眼睛传送到大脑，因此对其损伤可能会导致严重的视力问题。

paras.en: Study Links GLP-1 Drugs to Rare Vision Loss
paras.zh: 研究表明 GLP-1 药物与罕见的视力丧失有关

paras.en: The study, published in Annals of Internal Medicine, analyzed information from a large database of US adults ages 18 to 65 with Type 2 diabetes. Researchers focused on patients who had recently started taking medications to manage their condition, including a class of drugs known as glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists, or GLP-1s.
paras.zh: 这项发表在《内科医学年鉴》上的研究分析了美国 18 至 65 岁患有 2 型糖尿病成年人的大型数据库中的信息。研究人员重点关注最近开始服用药物来控制病情的患者，其中包括一类称为胰高血糖素样肽-1 受体激动剂 (GLP-1) 的药物。

paras.en: These medications include semaglutide (sold as Ozempic and Wegovy) and tirzepatide (sold as Mounjaro and Zepbound). In addition to helping control blood sugar and manage weight, GLP-1 medications can reduce the risks of certain cardiovascular and kidney problems. However, scientists are still investigating their potential side effects as their use becomes increasingly widespread.
paras.zh: 这些药物包括索马鲁肽（以 Ozempic 和 Wegovy 的名称出售）和替泽帕肽（以 Mounjaro 和 Zepbound 的名称出售）。除了帮助控制血糖和控制体重外，GLP-1 药物还可以降低某些心血管和肾脏问题的风险。然而，随着它们的使用变得越来越广泛，科学家们仍在研究它们潜在的副作用。

paras.en: The researchers found that GLP-1 use was associated with a modest increase in the likelihood of ischemic optic neuropathy. Although the condition was uncommon, its potential consequences make the finding important.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，GLP-1 的使用与缺血性视神经病变的可能性适度增加有关。尽管这种情况并不常见，但其潜在的后果使得这一发现变得很重要。

paras.en: "Although ischemic optic neuropathy was rare, it is clinically important because it can involve sudden vision loss," said Chintan Dave, a core faculty member of the Center for Pharmacoepidemiology and Treatment Science at Rutgers Institute for Health, Health Care Policy and Aging Research. "The increase in risk was small -- approximately three to four additional cases per 10,000 patients treated with GLP-1s over 18 months, but clinicians and patients should be aware of this potential association."
paras.zh: 罗格斯大学健康、医疗保健政策和老龄化研究所药物流行病学和治疗科学中心的核心教员 Chintan Dave 说：“虽然缺血性视神经病变很少见，但它在临床上很重要，因为它可能会导致突然视力丧失。” “风险的增加很小——在 18 个月内每 10,000 名接受 GLP-1 治疗的患者中大约会增加 3 到 4 例病例，但临床医生和患者应该意识到这种潜在的关联。”

paras.en: While the absolute risk remains low, researchers say the growing popularity of GLP-1 medications makes continued safety monitoring especially important. These drugs are now widely prescribed to people both with and without Type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 尽管绝对风险仍然很低，但研究人员表示，GLP-1 药物的日益普及使得持续的安全监测变得尤为重要。这些药物现在广泛用于患有和未患有 2 型糖尿病的人。

paras.en: The study also identified patterns among patients who developed the eye condition. Cases were more common among men and adults in the older portion of the study population.
paras.zh: 该研究还确定了患有眼部疾病的患者的模式。在研究人群的老年部分中，病例在男性和成年人中更为常见。

paras.en: "Most patients in our study who had ischemic optic neuropathy were either men or men and women aged 50 to 65," said Dave, an associate professor at the Ernest Mario School of Pharmacy and the lead author of the study. "Because ischemic optic neuropathy can present with sudden vision loss, which may be permanent, early recognition of symptoms and prompt ophthalmologic evaluation may be especially important for patients at higher baseline risk."
paras.zh: “我们研究中大多数患有缺血性视神经病变的患者都是男性或年龄在 50 至 65 岁之间的男性和女性，”欧内斯特马里奥药学院副教授、该研究的主要作者 Dave 说。 “由于缺血性视神经病变可能会出现突然的视力丧失，这可能是永久性的，因此早期识别症状并及时进行眼科评估对于基线风险较高的患者可能尤其重要。”

paras.en: More than 80% of ischemic optic neuropathy cases are estimated to involve the non-arteritic anterior form of the condition. This occurs when blood supply to the front portion of the optic nerve becomes insufficient, potentially damaging the nerve and interfering with vision.
paras.zh: 据估计，超过 80% 的缺血性视神经病变病例涉及非动脉炎性前部病变。当视神经前部的血液供应不足时，就会发生这种情况，可能会损害神经并干扰视力。

paras.en: The resulting vision loss is often permanent. According to Dave, approximately one-third of affected patients experience some recovery, usually during the first six months. Even when improvement occurs, some degree of visual impairment typically remains.
paras.zh: 由此导致的视力丧失通常是永久性的。据戴夫介绍，大约三分之一的受影响患者通常会在前六个月内康复。即使出现改善，通常仍会存在一定程度的视力障碍。

paras.en: Rather than causing complete blindness, the condition usually affects part of the vision in one eye. Patients may notice sudden blurriness, dimming, or missing areas in their field of view.
paras.zh: 这种情况通常会影响一只眼睛的部分视力，而不是导致完全失明。患者可能会注意到视野突然模糊、变暗或缺失区域。

paras.en: Do Weight Loss Drugs Actually Cause Vision Loss?
paras.zh: 减肥药真的会导致视力下降吗？

paras.en: Despite the association, the researchers caution that their findings do not establish that GLP-1 medications directly cause optic nerve damage.
paras.zh: 尽管存在这种关联，研究人员警告说，他们的研究结果并未证实 GLP-1 药物直接导致视神经损伤。

paras.en: Other factors, including differences in patients' underlying health conditions, could help explain the increased risk observed in the study. Additional research will be necessary to determine whether the medications themselves contribute to the condition.
paras.zh: 其他因素，包括患者基本健康状况的差异，可能有助于解释研究中观察到的风险增加。需要进行更多的研究来确定药物本身是否会导致这种情况。

paras.en: For now, the findings highlight the importance of recognizing sudden vision changes and seeking prompt medical evaluation, particularly among people who may already be at greater risk.
paras.zh: 目前，研究结果强调了识别视力突然变化并立即寻求医疗评估的重要性，特别是对于那些可能已经面临更大风险的人来说。

paras.en: The research team also included Kamika Reynolds and Kimberly O'Malley of the Institute for Health, along with Jason Roy of the Rutgers School of Public Health.
paras.zh: 该研究小组还包括健康研究所的卡米卡·雷诺兹和金伯利·奥马利，以及罗格斯大学公共卫生学院的贾森·罗伊。

paras.en: Materials provided by Rutgers University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由罗格斯大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Kamika R. Reynolds, Kimberly M. OâMalley, Jason A. Roy, Chintan V. Dave. Glucagon-like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists and Risk for Ischemic Optic Neuropathy. Annals of Internal Medicine, 2026; 179 (9): 1244 DOI: 10.7326/ANNALS-25-00860
paras.zh: - Kamika R. Reynolds、Kimberly M. OâMalley、Jason A. Roy、Chintan V. Dave。胰高血糖素样肽 1 受体激动剂和缺血性视神经病变的风险。内科年鉴，2026； 179 (9): 1244 DOI: 10.7326/ANNALS-25-00860

articles.title: 'Dungeon Crawler Carl' author Matt Dinniman talks inspirations, success, and the upcoming Peacock TV series (interview)
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: Fall has officially arrived, and as autumn leaves blaze in vivid colors, there is no better time to plunge into the imaginative world of New York Times best-selling author Matt Dinniman's "Dungeon Crawler Carl", the wildly addictive science fantasy book series that's taking the world by storm.
paras.zh: 秋天已经正式到来，秋叶披上鲜艳的色彩，现在正是沉浸在《纽约时报》畅销书作家马特·丁尼曼的《地下城爬行者卡尔》的想象世界的最佳时机，这是一本风靡全球的令人着迷的科学奇幻系列丛书。

paras.en: Even if you haven't read them, you've probably seen folks carrying these books, emblazoned with their loud, neon-colored covers, at your neighborhood coffee house. You'll see it even more in the future, too, as a streaming adaptation of the novels is coming to Peacock, with Seth MacFarlane's Fuzzy Door and co-showrunners Eric Heisserer and Chris Yost at the helm.
paras.zh: 即使您没有读过这些书，您也可能在附近的咖啡馆见过人们拿着这些书，这些书的封面上印有鲜艳的霓虹色封面。未来你还会看到更多，因为小说的流媒体改编版将在 Peacock 上播出，由塞思·麦克法兰的《模糊门》以及联合剧集制作人埃里克·海瑟尔和克里斯·约斯特掌舵。

paras.en: The eighth book in the series, "A Parade of Horribles," dropped in May of 2026 and continues the story of Carl and his ex-girlfriend’s precocious pussy cat named Princess Donut as they try to navigate the dangerously daunting levels of a lethal doomsday dungeon for an intergalactic television show deciding the fate of humanity and the planet Earth.
paras.zh: 该系列的第八本书《恐怖游行》于 2026 年 5 月推出，继续讲述卡尔和他前女友早熟的小猫咪甜甜圈公主的故事，他们试图在致命的末日地牢的危险和令人畏惧的关卡中穿行，因为一部星际电视节目决定了人类和地球的命运。

paras.en: Think Douglas Adams's "The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy" meets "The Running Man" and "Ready Player One" in the "Dungeons & Dragons" RPG realm, and you've got a pretty good idea of the stylistic narrative you'll soon discover when you dare to enter Dinniman's slightly demented literary world.
paras.zh: 想想道格拉斯·亚当斯的《银河系漫游指南》在《龙与地下城》角色扮演游戏领域中与《奔跑吧兄弟》和《头号玩家》相遇，当你敢于进入丁尼曼略显疯狂的文学世界时，你很快就会发现这种叙事风格的相当不错的想法。

paras.en: "The genesis is that I’ve been writing my whole life, and I have a thousand story ideas," Dinniman tells Space on the origins of his sci-fi sensation. "I’ve kept a running list of ideas since childhood, and this one had been on there for some time. The line in my list for this particular one was 'Alien' game show.'"
paras.zh: “起源是我一生都在写作，我有一千个故事想法，”丁尼曼告诉《太空》他的科幻小说的起源。 “我从小就一直保留着一份不断变化的想法清单，这个想法已经存在了一段时间了。我的清单中这个特定的想法是‘外星人’游戏节目。”

paras.en: With over 14 million copies of the "Dungeon Crawler Carl" series sold to date, spooky season is the ideal jumping-on moment so you can share your favorite sadistic dungeon level kill next time you're at a cool cocktail party or fun family function!
paras.zh: “地下城爬行者卡尔”系列迄今为止已售出超过 1400 万份，恐怖季节是理想的入门时刻，因此您可以在下次参加炫酷的鸡尾酒会或有趣的家庭活动时分享您最喜欢的施虐地牢关卡杀戮！

paras.en: "The success is a whole other question. I think I just happened to hit the right story at the right time," admits Dinniman. "It's about a man pushing back against impossible odds. The antagonist isn't just a single person or entity, but an entire system designed to crush any life out of him, all for the entertainment of the masses. That sort of story seems to really be resonating right now. Plus there's a talking cat in it."
paras.zh: “成功与否是另一个问题。我想我只是碰巧在正确的时间遇到​​了正确的故事，”丁尼曼承认道。 “这是关于一个人对抗不可能的困难的故事。对手不仅仅是一个人或实体，而是一个旨在摧毁他任何生命的整个系统，这一切都是为了大众的娱乐。这样的故事现在似乎真的引起了共鸣。而且里面还有一只会说话的猫。”

paras.en: Dinniman has described the most recently-released sequel as "the Carl and Donut version of Mariokart—only deadlier," with the cruel dungeon architects tightening their brutal grip. As the current king of LitRPG titles in circulation, "Dungeon Crawler Carl" is the next best thing to a living video game.
paras.zh: 丁尼曼将最近发布的续集描述为“卡尔和甜甜圈版本的马里奥卡丁车——只是更致命”，残酷的地下城建筑师加强了他们的残酷控制。作为当前流通的 LitRPG 游戏之王，《地下城爬行者卡尔》是仅次于电子游戏的最佳选择。

paras.en: "Luckily I’m still in love with this story, and I am in love with writing it," he admits. "It hasn’t gotten old yet. The end is in sight, and I’m more sad than anything that it'll eventually be over."
paras.zh: “幸运的是，我仍然热爱这个故事，并且我热爱写作它，”他承认。 “它还没有变老。结局就在眼前，我比任何事情都更悲伤，它最终会结束。”

paras.en: An episodic series adaptation seems like a no-brainer, and Peacock has wisely tapped into the considerable talents of both Heisserer ("Arrival," "Bird Box") and Yost ("Thor: The Dark World," "Thor: Ragnarok") for this ambitious TV project.
paras.zh: 剧集改编似乎是理所当然的事情，皮科克明智地利用了海瑟尔（《降临》、《鸟盒》）和约斯特（《雷神：黑暗世界》、《雷神：诸神黄昏》）的才华来完成这个雄心勃勃的电视项目。

paras.en: "Both Chris and Eric have a great amount of experience in Hollywood, but more importantly, both have read the books and like them," Dinniman notes. "Chris is a mega fan, and Eric knows more about gaming than any adult probably should. That's a great combination."
paras.zh: “克里斯和埃里克在好莱坞都有丰富的经验，但更重要的是，他们都读过这些书并且喜欢它们，”丁尼曼指出。 “克里斯是一名超级粉丝，而埃里克对游戏的了解比任何成年人都多。这是一个很棒的组合。”

paras.en: Dinniman also confirmed to us that he's serving as co-executive producer on the show, and will be involved throughout the production.
paras.zh: 丁尼曼还向我们证实，他将担任该剧的联合执行制片人，并将参与整个制作过程。

paras.en: "The most important thing to preserve, I think, is the tone, which will also be the most challenging," states Dinniman. "Thankfully, the team that's been assembled is up to the challenge, and I can't wait for the world to see how it turns out."
paras.zh: “我认为，最重要的是要保留语气，这也是最具挑战性的，”丁尼曼说。 “值得庆幸的是，组建的团队能够迎接挑战，我迫不及待地想让全世界看看结果如何。”

paras.en: With eight books released so far (and another two to come), you've got plenty of reading to do before the Peacock show and/or the next book lands. You can find the Dungeon Crawler Carl book series in your local bookstores and on Amazon. It's also available via Kindle e-readers and as an audiobook.
paras.zh: 到目前为止已经发行了八本书（还有另外两本书即将出版），在孔雀秀和/或下一本书登陆之前，您有大量的阅读要做。您可以在当地的书店和亚马逊上找到《地下城爬行者卡尔》系列图书。它还可以通过 Kindle 电子阅读器和有声读物的形式获得。

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

articles.title: Planetary genealogy: Milky Way worlds belong to 1 of 2 ‘families,’ scientists find
articles.author: Robert Lea

paras.en: You can tell a lot about how a child will age by looking at their parents, and it turns out that this could be true for planetary systems, too. Scientists have performed cosmic genealogy on planetary systems in the Milky Way, finding two distinct families that influence the evolution and fate of these systems.
paras.zh: 通过观察孩子的父母，你可以了解很多关于孩子如何变老的信息，事实证明，对于行星系统来说也是如此。科学家们对银河系的行星系统进行了宇宙谱系学研究，发现了两个影响这些系统的演化和命运的不同家族。

paras.en: The study team, led by researchers at the Italian National Institute for Astrophysics (INAF), studied 300 of the best-understood multiplanet systems of the over 1,000 that astronomers have discovered in the Milky Way.
paras.zh: 该研究小组由意大利国家天体物理研究所 (INAF) 的研究人员领导，研究了天文学家在银河系发现的 1000 多个多行星系统中的 300 个最容易理解的多行星系统。

paras.en: The team's research clarifies how the environments around infant stars directly affect planetary fates and, in turn, the survival of extrasolar planets, or exoplanets, that are potentially capable of hosting life. That could be crucial as astronomers search for life beyond the solar system, pointing them to systems with potentially habitable planets like Earth.
paras.zh: 该团队的研究阐明了婴儿恒星周围的环境如何直接影响行星的命运，进而影响可能孕育生命的太阳系外行星或系外行星的生存。当天文学家寻找太阳系以外的生命并为他们指出具有像地球这样的潜在宜居行星的系统时，这可能至关重要。

paras.en: "The fundamental question we started from was: What determines the characteristics of planetary systems as we see them today? Are they established at birth or sculpted by evolution over time? The truth, in the end, turned out to lie somewhere in the middle," team member and INAF researcher Diego Turrini said in a statement sent to Space.com.
paras.zh: 团队成员、INAF 研究员迭戈·图里尼 (Diego Turrini) 在发给 Space.com 的一份声明中表示：“我们首先提出的基本问题是：是什么决定了我们今天所看到的行星系统的特征？它们是在诞生时就已经形成的，还是随着时间的推移而形成的？事实最终证明是介于两者之间。”

paras.en: "Our results show that there is a genetic link between planetary systems and their stars, and that, depending on the star around which they are born, this link also determines their fate," Turrini added.
paras.zh: 图里尼补充说：“我们的研究结果表明，行星系统与其恒星之间存在遗传联系，并且根据它们诞生周围的恒星，这种联系也决定了它们的命运。”

paras.en: What is the genetic code of a planetary system?
paras.zh: 行星系统的遗传密码是什么？

paras.en: The first "family" the scientists identified consists of wide, massive systems, often with total masses between two and 10 times that of our own solar system. The planets in these systems orbit stars more massive than the sun with lower concentrations of elements heavier than hydrogen and helium (which astronomers somewhat confusingly call metals) than seen in our star.
paras.zh: 科学家们确定的第一个“家族”由广阔、巨大的系统组成，总质量通常是我们太阳系的两倍到十倍。这些系统中的行星围绕比太阳质量更大的恒星运行，其比氢和氦（天文学家有些混淆地称为金属）重的元素浓度低于我们恒星中看到的浓度。

paras.en: The second family is more compact and lower-mass systems. The members of this family are composed of planets with comparable masses and sizes, a so-called "peas-in-a-pod" configuration. They orbit stars with mass and metallicity equal to or lower than those of the sun, with orbits that are usually much tighter than those of Mercury, the closest planet to the sun.
paras.zh: 第二个系列是更紧凑、质量更轻的系统。这个家族的成员由质量和大小相当的行星组成，即所谓的“豆荚里的豌豆”结构。它们绕质量和金属丰度等于或低于太阳的恒星运行，其轨道通常比距离太阳最近的行星水星的轨道要紧得多。

paras.en: One of the "genes" Turrini and colleagues selected to sort planetary systems into families was the deviations that planets make from orbiting their star in the same circular plane. That, in turn, reveals a family history of violent gravitational instability caused by events like giant collisions and planetary ejections.
paras.zh: 图里尼和同事选择将行星系统分类的“基因”之一是行星在同一圆形平面上绕恒星运行的偏差。这反过来又揭示了由巨大碰撞和行星抛射等事件引起的剧烈引力不稳定的家族史。

paras.en: Violent events were common for the first family, but much less so for the second group of planetary systems, the researchers found. They determined that the number of these turbulent events a planetary system experiences can be linked to even modest variations in the environment in which planets form. These variations arise due to different properties of the parent star of those systems.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，暴力事件在第一组行星系统中很常见，但在第二组行星系统中则少得多。他们确定，行星系统经历的这些湍流事件的数量可能与行星形成环境的微小变化有关。这些变化是由于这些系统的母星的不同特性而产生的。

paras.en: Thus, the nature of the star in these systems doesn't just fundamentally change the formation of planets in their systems; it influences the system's future evolution, determining whether it will be characterized by phases of marked instability and giant impacts.
paras.zh: 因此，这些系统中恒星的性质不仅从根本上改变了系统中行星的形成，而且还改变了行星的形成。它影响系统的未来演化，决定它是否会出现明显不稳定和巨大影响的阶段。

paras.en: "The main difficulty during the data analysis was determining whether the two families of planetary systems were real or just an illusion created by the technological limits of current observational techniques," said team member Camilla Danielski, of the University of Valencia in Spain.
paras.zh: 西班牙瓦伦西亚大学的团队成员卡米拉·丹尼尔斯基说：“数据分析过程中的主要困难是确定这两个行星系统家族是真实的，还是只是由于当前观测技术的技术限制而产生的幻觉。”

paras.en: "At the end of the path, it became clear that selection effects acted as the tip of the iceberg, revealing the existence of much deeper structural diversities between these systems," Danielski said.
paras.zh: 丹尼尔斯基说：“在这条道路的尽头，很明显，选择效应只是冰山一角，揭示了这些系统之间存在更深层次的结构多样性。”

paras.en: The scientists tested their conclusions by running simulations of planetary system evolution, all of which began with different conditions.
paras.zh: 科学家们通过运行行星系统演化模拟来测试他们的结论，所有这些模拟都是从不同的条件开始的。

paras.en: "The scenarios that best reproduce the dynamical properties of the family of wide and massive systems are those in which the systems are unstable from birth," said research supervisor and INAF researcher Danae Polychroni. "The greater abundance of material from which planets form around their host stars causes them to be born too large, preventing the system from remaining stable."
paras.zh: 研究主管兼 INAF 研究员达娜厄·波利克罗尼 (Danae Polychroni) 表示：“最能再现宽大系统家族动态特性的场景是系统从诞生起就不稳定的场景。” “行星围绕其主恒星形成的物质越丰富，导致它们诞生时太大，从而阻止系统保持稳定。”

paras.en: The team's research was published on Tuesday (Oct. 13) in the journal Nature Astronomy.
paras.zh: 该团队的研究成果于周二（10 月 13 日）发表在《自然天文学》杂志上。

paras.en: Robert Lea is a science journalist in the U.K. whose articles have been published in Physics World, New Scientist, Astronomy Magazine, All About Space, Newsweek and ZME Science. He also writes about science communication for Elsevier and the European Journal of Physics. Rob holds a bachelor of science degree in physics and astronomy from the U.K.’s Open University. Follow him on Twitter @sciencef1rst.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·李 (Robert Lea) 是一位英国科学记者，其文章发表在《物理世界》、《新科学家》、《天文学杂志》、《All About Space》、《新闻周刊》和《ZME Science》上。他还为爱思唯尔和《欧洲物理学杂志》撰写有关科学传播的文章。 Rob 拥有英国开放大学物理和天文学理学学士学位。在 Twitter 上关注他@sciencef1rst。

articles.title: Watch SpaceX deliver more than 6,000 pounds of cargo to the ISS today
articles.author: Josh Dinner

paras.en: A Dragon is closing the gap between itself and its destination after a more than two-day-long orbital pursuit.
paras.zh: 经过两天多的轨道追踪后，“龙”号正在缩小与目的地之间的距离。

paras.en: SpaceX's cargo Dragon, flying the CRS-35 (35th Commercial Resupply Services) mission for NASA, is scheduled to rendezvous with the International Space Station (ISS) this morning (Oct. 15), delivering fresh food, long-term provisions, research and hardware to the orbital lab and its crew.
paras.zh: SpaceX 的货运龙飞船正在为 NASA 执行 CRS-35（第 35 次商业补给服务）任务，计划于今天早上（10 月 15 日）与国际空间站 (ISS) 会合，为轨道实验室及其机组人员运送新鲜食物、长期物资、研究成果和硬件。

paras.en: Coverage of Dragon's arrival at the ISS will begin at 9:15 a.m. EDT (1315 GMT), with docking scheduled for approximately 11 a.m. EDT (1500 GMT). A livestream of the rendezvous will be available here and on Space.com's homepage, courtesy of NASA.
paras.zh: 龙飞船抵达国际空间站的报道将于美国东部时间上午 9 点 15 分（格林尼治标准时间 1315 点）开始，预计对接时间为美国东部时间上午 11 点（格林威治标准时间 1500 点）左右。由 NASA 提供的交会现场直播将在此处和 Space.com 主页上进行。

paras.en: CRS-35 launched on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from the company's pad at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida on Tuesday (Oct. 13). Liftoff occurred at 6:35 a.m. EDT (1035 GMT), and the Falcon 9's upper stage deployed the Dragon in low Earth orbit (LEO) a short 10 minutes later. Thanks to the trajectory of the space station's orbit and the near-dawn hour of the launch, the Falcon 9's ascent to orbit was viewed by millions up and down the U.S. East Coast, who witnessed a rare "space jellyfish" phenomenon from the rocket's exhaust plume.
paras.zh: 周二（10 月 13 日），CRS-35 通过 SpaceX 猎鹰 9 号火箭从该公司位于佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站的发射台发射升空。美国东部时间上午 6 点 35 分（格林尼治标准时间 1035）升空，短短 10 分钟后，猎鹰 9 号的上级将龙号部署到近地轨道 (LEO)。由于空间站的轨道轨迹和发射时间接近黎明，美国东海岸上下数百万人目睹了猎鹰 9 号升入轨道的过程，他们目睹了火箭排气羽流中罕见的“太空水母”现象。

paras.en: The supplies headed to the ISS on CRS-35 will largely support its newest astronaut inhabitants, the members of SpaceX's Crew-13 mission for NASA. The four-person crew arrived aboard the ISS on Oct. 1, relieving the members of Crew-12, who returned to Earth a week later.
paras.zh: CRS-35 运往国际空间站的物资将主要支持其最新的宇航员居民，即 SpaceX 为 NASA 执行 Crew-13 任务的成员。四名宇航员于 10 月 1 日抵达国际空间站，接替了 Crew-12 的成员，后者于一周后返回地球。

paras.en: Crew-12 astronauts will address the media this afternoon (Oct. 15) to discuss their mission and their return after nearly eight months on orbit. A live broadcast of that event will also be available to stream on Space.com's homepage beginning at 3:30 p.m. EDT (1930 GMT).
paras.zh: Crew-12 宇航员将于今天下午（10 月 15 日）向媒体发表讲话，讨论他们的任务以及在轨道上运行近八个月后的返回情况。该活动的现场直播也将于下午 3:30 开始在 Space.com 主页上进行直播。美国东部时间（1930 GMT）。

paras.en: Cargo Dragon's nominal orbital insertion on Tuesday placed it on course to catch up with the ISS after a 51-hour LEO chase. After rendezvous this morning, Dragon will autonomously dock to the zenith port on the station's Harmony module. It will remain docked with the ISS for about a month before being packed with supplies, waste and research for its return, safe splashdown and recovery on Earth.
paras.zh: 周二，货运龙号名义上进入轨道，在经过 51 小时的近地轨道追逐后，它有望赶上国际空间站。今天早上交会后，“龙”号将自动停靠在空间站和谐模块的天顶端口。它将与国际空间站对接大约一个月，然后装满补给品、废物和研究成果，以便返回、安全溅落和在地球上回收。

paras.en: Josh Dinner is Space.com's Spaceflight Staff Writer. He is a writer and photographer with a passion for science and space exploration, and has been working the space beat since 2016. Josh has covered the evolution of NASA's Artemis program and humanity's return to the moon, commercial spaceflight partnerships and crewed missions from the Space Coast, NASA science missions and more. He also enjoys building 1:144-scale model rockets and spacecraft. Find some of Josh's launch photography on Instagram, and follow him on X, where he mostly posts in haiku.
paras.zh: 乔什·丁纳 (Joshdinner) 是 Space.com 的 Spaceflight 特约撰稿人。他是一位对科学和太空探索充满热情的作家和摄影师，自 2016 年以来一直致力于太空节拍。乔什报道了 NASA 阿尔忒弥斯计划的演变和人类重返月球、商业航天合作伙伴关系以及太空海岸的载人任务、NASA 科学任务等。他还喜欢建造 1:144 比例的火箭和航天器模型。在 Instagram 上查找 Josh 的一些首发照片，并在 X 上关注他，他主要在 X 上发布俳句。
